title: 📝General Updates
author: Jonathan Hill

body:
Hey everyone! I know the pings have been frequent lately but we’ve been getting a lot done. 😎 Got another batch of updates and fixes for you. As always, report any feedback or issues. Thanks!

💎Socketing:

  • Horse armor, wolf armor, and harnesses can now be socketed.

    • All can be increased to 11 armor and 2 armor toughness, the same as Diamond Horse Armor.

    • Horse and wolf armor can hold 4 stat gems, while harnesses can hold 6. Gems of Agility socketed into harnesses instead increase fly speed.

  • Gems of Tenacity now additionally grant +5% stun resist. This means full tenacity armor reduces stun durations by 80%.

🎮Gameplay:

  • You can now capture Happy Ghasts in eggs.

  • You now have 64 block reach in the creative world by default. This can be toggled off with ‘/toggle creative_world block_reach.’

  • The Hawking Warp can now be used anywhere outside of parkours, though no longer goes through walls.

🖥️Commands:

  • Added ‘/map’ to get a link to the live server map.

  • Added ‘/toggle sounds combat_end’ to enable a subtle sound when you exit combat.

  • Added ‘/vaporize <player>’ as a new simple command (Fine!)

🪲Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed Impetus of Hades allowing you to stealth in view of players in PvP arenas.

  • Fixed Mulching still giving seeds when used with Magnetism.

  • Fixed Noclip warping you when sprinting towards a ladder on a thin wall.

  • Fixed display copy pasting not always working for displays of items with custom stack sizes (cakes, potions, etc.)

🫶
